title: unified-rollouts: add quorum-based quarantine metric and staged-shadow probing autorollback
author: Arielle Chen
description:
Motivation: rolling model updates in production increasingly surface transient regressions in narrow traffic slices. Current autorollback triggers are metric-threshold based but can be noisy when a single signal spikes. This change introduces a quorum-based quarantine metric that requires a configurable number of independent metric violations before triggering quarantine/rollback. It also integrates staged-shadow probing into the probing pipeline so that shadow traffic probes can vote into the quorum and provide early signals without affecting live traffic.

Summary of changes: added a QuorumPolicy for autorollback that aggregates independent metric voters (latency, token-error-rate, semantic drift via eval-set scoring, and inference error counts). Implemented a QuarantineCoordinator to track per-rollout voting and enforce time windows and minimum sample counts. Extended the staged-shadow probing workflow to emit voter events and to include shadow probe results in quorum calculations under a configurable weight. Added observability hooks and dashboards so SREs can see voter breakdown, quorum progress, and quarantine history.

Key behaviors: - Quorum requires N distinct voter groups to exceed thresholds within a sliding window before quarantine is opened. - Shadow probe votes are included but can be configured to be advisory-only (do not count towards quorum) for initial rollouts. - A quarantine opens a rollback timer; if remediation fails or quorum persists past the timer, the rollout is automatically rolled back. - Safety guards: canary cohorts below minimum traffic are excluded; manual override remains possible via rollout API.

Testing and validation: unit tests for QuorumPolicy logic and quorum timeout behavior; integration tests for staged-shadow probe end-to-end voting; e2e smoke across rollout controller + scheduler. Added load benches to verify quorum bookkeeping cost is negligible at P95 traffic volumes. Ran staged rollout against internal canary (redwood-demo) with advisory shadow votes enabled; observed quorum correctly trip only when semantic drift and latency correlated.

Rollout plan: feature-flag gated behind rollout.quorum.enabled (off by default). Gradual enablement: enable advisory shadow votes for 24h, enable vote counting in a single staging region, monitor dashboards and alerts (ENG-7521).

Related: builds on previous autorollback enhancements (PRs ENG-... referenced in Linear). Addresses customer incidents where single-signal flapping caused noisy rollbacks.

Checklist: - [x] Implementation - [x] Unit tests - [x] Integration tests - [x] Docs - [x] Dashboards and alerts - [x] Feature flag gating

review_comments: Diego Morales (reviewer): Can we add a config to keep shadow votes advisory-only for the first rollout window? I don't want production shadow traffic to prematurely trigger rollbacks.
Arielle Chen (author): Added rollout.quorum.shadow_advisory flag and defaulted it to true. Updated docs to call out the gradual enablement plan.
Priya Natarajan (reviewer): The QuarantineCoordinator state seems racy when multiple rollouts touch the same model. Please add a linearizable lock or track by rollout id.
Arielle Chen (author): Switched to per-rollout partitioned coordinator + optimistic compare-and-swap; added unit tests that reproduce the race and assert correctness.
Samir Patel (reviewer): Observability looks good but can we emit voter provenance (probe vs live) as a tag for troubleshooting?
Arielle Chen (author): Added provenance tag and updated the telemetry dashboard to break down votes by provenance.
release_notes: Introduce quorum-based quarantine policy and staged-shadow voting for autorollback. Feature gated behind rollout.quorum.enabled. Adds new telemetry and alerts for quorum progress. Backwards compatible; off by default.
